title: 第13章 符文第14章 龙吟
lines: 秘银徽章冰冷的触感仿佛还残留在指尖。
卡拉斯背靠着潮湿的货舱板壁，每次船体在风浪中摇晃，断裂的肋骨和伤口都传来撕裂般的疼痛。
昏暗的提灯在舱顶摇晃，投下扭曲的阴影。
暗爪蜷缩在他怀里，覆盖着星尘鳞片的身躯随着船体颠簸微微起伏。
它紧闭着熔金的竖瞳，呼吸急促微弱，胸膛上那道被符文戟刺穿的伤口边缘覆盖着死灰色的冰晶污染。
货舱空气污浊，咸腥味、霉味和劣质油脂味混合在一起。
更深处传来细微的“沙沙”
声，像是金属颗粒在摩擦滚动。
这声音让暗爪不安，即使在虚弱中，它也会在声音响起时身体僵硬，鳞片下残留的暗紫能量不安窜动。
船体剧烈倾斜，卡拉斯和暗爪被狠狠抛向板壁。
撞击让卡拉斯眼前发黑，喉头涌上血腥味。
暗爪发出一声痛苦的嘶鸣，伤口处的冰晶裂开细纹。
舱门被粗暴拉开。
独眼船长堵在门口，湿透的头发贴在额头上，脸上带着暴躁和嫌恶。
“妈的！
这鬼天气！”
他咒骂着，指向暗爪，“管好你那玩意儿！
再弄出动静，老子亲手把它丢下海喂鲨鱼！”
舱门被重重摔上，将威胁锁在幽闭的货舱里。
卡拉斯喘息着，强忍剧痛坐直，护住因撞击而更痛苦的暗爪。
他能感觉到幼龙的僵硬和颤抖，感受到灵魂链接中传来的狂暴怒意。
“安静…撑住…”
他染血的手指轻抚暗爪的脊背，试图安抚。
但这安抚引来了更强烈的反噬。
暗爪猛地挣扎，熔金竖瞳睁开，燃烧着狂怒和混乱的紫焰。
一股混乱的暗影能量从它体内爆发，冲击着灵魂链接的枷锁。
短促尖锐的嘶鸣在货舱内炸响。
舱门被猛地踹开。
独眼船长冲了进来，脸上带着狂怒和惊惧。
content_en:
The cold touch of the mithril badge still seemed to remain on the fingertips.
Karas leaned against the damp cargo hold wall. Every time the hull rocked in the wind and waves, there was tearing pain from the broken ribs and wounds.
Dim lanterns swayed on the cabin ceiling, casting distorted shadows.
Darkpaw curled up in his arms, his body covered with stardust scales rising and falling slightly as the ship's hull jolted.
It closed its molten gold vertical pupils tightly, its breathing was rapid and weak, and the edge of the wound on its chest pierced by the rune halberd was covered with dead gray ice crystal pollution.
The air in the cargo hold was dirty, with a mixture of salty, musty, and inferior oil smells.
A subtle "rustling" came from deeper
The sound was like metal particles rubbing and rolling.
This sound made Darkclaw uneasy. Even in its weakness, it would stiffen when the sound sounded, and the remaining dark purple energy under its scales would move uneasily.
"Crack-!"
The hull tilted violently, and Karas and Darkclaw were thrown hard against the board.
The impact made Karas's eyes black, and the smell of blood filled his throat.
Darkclaw let out a painful cry, and the ice crystals at the wound cracked into fine lines.
The hatch was violently opened.
The one-eyed captain blocked the door, his wet hair stuck to his forehead, and his face was filled with irritability and disgust.
"Damn it!
What a damn weather! "
He cursed and pointed at Darkclaw, "Watch that thing of yours!
If it makes any more noise, I will personally throw it into the sea and feed it to the sharks! "
The hatch was slammed shut, locking the threat in the claustrophobic cargo hold.
Karas gasped, enduring the severe pain and sitting upright, protecting the dark claws that were even more painful from the impact.
He could feel the stiffness and trembling of the young dragon, and felt the violent anger coming from the soul link.
"Quiet...hold on..."
He stroked Darkpaw's back with his bloody fingers, trying to comfort him.
But this reassurance triggered a stronger backlash.
Dark Claw struggled violently, and his molten gold vertical pupils opened, burning with purple flames of rage and chaos.
A chaotic shadow energy erupted from its body, impacting the shackles of the soul link.
"Hiss——!"
A short, sharp scream exploded in the cargo hold.
The hatch was kicked open violently.
The one-eyed captain rushed in, a look of fury and fear on his face.
